Session Handoff — 2026-06-13

Source: HANDOFF.md

Completed — bibnets 0.5.0 (committed to main and dev)

Headline feature: custom columns + separators for every builder

A non-standard CSV / data frame now builds a network in one call — no renaming, no manual splitting:

author_network(d, authors = "Author Names", sep = ",")
keyword_network(d, keywords = "Tags", sep = ",")
reference_network(d, references = "Cited Refs", sep = ",")
document_network(d, references = "Cited Refs", sep = ",")
source_network(d, journal = "Source title")
country_network(d, countries = "Nations", sep = ",")
institution_network(d, affiliations = "Orgs", sep = ",")
local_citations(d, references = "cites", sep = ",")
historiograph(d, references = "cites", sep = ",")
conetwork(d, field = "country", by = "topic", sep = ",")

Each builder’s column selector is named after its entity (not a generic field). All new args sit at the end of each signature, so existing positional calls (author_network(d, "collaboration", "fractional")) are unaffected.

Two extra arguments

  • references_sep (default ";") on author/country/institution/source — the coupling references column gets its own delimiter, independent of sep (reference strings contain internal commas).
  • strip_quotes (default TRUE, every builder) — strips surrounding quotes ("Alice", ""Alice"", curly) from entities; FALSE keeps them. Implemented once in ensure_list_column() via strip_surrounding_quotes() (R/utils.R, ASCII-safe scapes), threaded through build_bipartite/build_author_bipartite so FALSE is honored; source_network strips its scalar journal inline.

Bug fixes folded in

  • Positional counting on a plain character author column now splits (was one mega-author per paper, silently).
  • co_citation honors self_loops; equivalence forwards deduplicate.
  • Wrong-separator warning fires only for structural delimiters (";", "|", tab); commas and " and " excluded so valid "Last, First" names / reference strings / "Smith and Sons" never warn (Codex P3).
  • historiograph() forwards strip_quotes to its internal local_citations() call so node selection matches edge labels (Codex P2).
  • read_biblio(format = "generic") warns + lists columns on a missing actors column.

Deprecation

  • keyword_network(field = ) -> keyword_network(keywords = ). Old arg still works (warns), kept in its original 2nd position.

Docs

  • New “Custom columns and separators (no reader needed)” section in vignettes/reading-data.Rmd (§12; old 12-16 renumbered 13-17), with runnable chunks for every new arg. Pointer added in bibnets.Rmd.
